findings.problem: Older open broker orders could disappear behind recent closed history
findings.root_cause: orders() requested only latest500 status=all, hiding foreign pending exposure
findings.repair: Read separate bounded open-order census, merge recent history by actual order ID; saturated500open census fails reconciliation

findings.problem: Malformed quote response could abort the remaining symbol refresh pass
findings.root_cause: Unexpected structures and out-of-range timestamps escaped exception containment
findings.repair: Validate chart structure and contain attribute/arithmetic/OS conversion failures per symbol while preserving saved quotes

findings.problem: Cached bar content bypassed immutable revision verification
findings.root_cause: bars() served cache JSON directly, including damaged or altered prices
findings.repair: Reconstruct returned cache content from verified immutable revision; unverified cache cannot be used as stale fallback

findings.problem: Positive but impossible OHLC bars were accepted
findings.root_cause: Only finite positive prices were checked
findings.repair: Require low<=open/close<=high and low<=high; prior valid revision remains available as visibly stale data

findings.problem: Bar ordering and duplicate identity depended on timezone spelling
findings.root_cause: Raw ISO strings sorted lexically, equivalent instants could evade duplicate detection
findings.repair: Normalize every accepted bar timestamp to UTC before chronological sorting and duplicate detection

findings.problem: Malformed or inconsistent archive evidence could escape integrity checks
findings.root_cause: Invalid JSON was an uncaught error; observations bypassed hash verification; receipt metadata was unchecked; identical fresh read could claim a corrupt existing revision
findings.repair: Centralize revision content/hash/metadata validation; expose explicit503 for corrupt archive, validate observations, refuse silently reusing corrupt immutable records

findings.problem: Oversized adapter response could be labelled complete after truncation
findings.root_cause: Adapter supplied truncated flag was trusted even if desk cut rows
findings.repair: Desk bound itself forces bounded_partial completeness

findings.problem: Historical adapter lost generator-supplied interval declarations
findings.repair: Materialize allowed intervals once and require a nonempty supported set

findings.problem: Historical adapter could claim a different provider identity
findings.root_cause: Payload provider field was accepted without matching the registered adapter
findings.repair: Require registered adapter identity to match returned provider provenance

findings.problem: Failed historical continuation retained healthy historical-provider status
findings.root_cause: Only primary transport telemetry changed; normalization exceptions escaped endpoint handling
findings.repair: Mark historical continuation unavailable, normalize malformed continuation errors to ProviderError and preserve original revision

findings.problem: Empty vendor history could overwrite the last useful bar cache
findings.root_cause: Empty bar lists were persisted as successful complete history
findings.repair: Reject empty historical responses and preserve prior verified history with stale-cache evidence

findings.problem: Socket read timeout allowed indefinitely dribbling HTTP response to stall supervisor
findings.root_cause: urllib timeout bounded individual socket operations, not total response completion
findings.repair: Use root-owned bounded_http transport with total8second connection/redirect/header/body deadline and8MB maximum; preserve HTTP404 semantics and reject Alpaca redirects

findings.problem: Invalid schedules could persist forever-retrying jobs or raise500 during registration
findings.root_cause: Zero/false interval coerced to default; nested unhashable enum inputs and invalid symbols/ranges/instructions unchecked
findings.repair: Validate enum and field types, intervals, symbols, bar range/granularity, text instructions and schedule ID before persistence

findings.problem: Operator pause or schedule disable could be ignored by already-selected work
findings.root_cause: Eligibility checked only when selecting job list and starting entire pass
findings.repair: Recheck current pause/enable state before each job, between operational stages and before broker mutation; expose same-transaction execution_fence for per-intent local accounting; retain due job as pending without fabricated failure

findings.problem: Interval edits used old cadence and could wait old long interval
findings.root_cause: Completion used captured schedule and configure did not recalculate stored next_due
findings.repair: Recalculate due from last successful completion when interval edited and use current schedule interval at job completion

findings.problem: Offline prior-day exchange windows were never recorded
findings.root_cause: Session materialization enumerated only current exchange day
findings.repair: Persist per-schedule cursors and catch up seven calendar days per pass, record expired windows skipped without replay, expose incomplete backlog/health, respect disabled periods and first observation

findings.problem: Extreme benchmark price ratio poisoned runtime JSON with Infinity
findings.root_cause: Benchmark context return did not check arithmetic finiteness
findings.repair: Withhold nonrepresentable return and record reason/status

findings.problem: Recovered job/storage warning remained active after condition was repaired
findings.root_cause: Successful retry had no corresponding automatic resolution
findings.repair: Resolve only confirmed successful job warning and confirmed healthy-storage warning using existing coordinator-attributed Lab.resolve_key; preserve historical missed-window warnings

findings.problem: Supervisor shutdown during reads could proceed to new financial execution
findings.root_cause: Shutdown stop_event affected outer loop only
findings.repair: Treat stop request as cooperative pause at operational and financial execution fences, preserving due work for recovery

verification.scope: Historical intermediate integration run:68 tests, including the five transport tests available then. The final command covers71 tests with eight transport tests; authoritative final320-test complete runs are recorded in FULL_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
entire shared backend suite as observed during integration; root will rerun after all agents freeze

cross_component_notes: Financial audit owner integrates execution_fence(con) inside local per-intent accounting transaction and final pre-submit transaction. Root final regression verifies this integration.
Analytics audit owner independently validates direct archive/cache reads and single-revision excursion coherence.
Root owns bounded_http implementation and actual loopback slow-response deadline tests; provider tests assert correct deadline/bound/status/redirect integration.
limits: No strategies added, automatic trade ideas originated, real or external paper broker orders sent, or external notifications sent.
All financial/scheduling/provider mutations used isolated test databases and simulated provider transports; default running desk database preserved.
Alpaca open-order census at500or more is intentionally unavailable rather than falsely complete; recent historical order window remains bounded to500 and is not a full account lifetime statement.
Source data remain vendor observations; per-bar publication times and independently certified exchange completeness are not inferred.

First session cursor observation defines known operating availability; no historical missed windows are invented before it. Current active window can be joined; expired offline known windows are recorded without execution. Seven calendar days per pass backlog is visible.

An explicit forced operator cycle can run while overall runtime is paused; disabling its schedule or requesting supervisor shutdown still fences it. Already-sent external requests/actual returned receipts cannot be undone.
Source snapshot hashes describe owned files at report creation; root delivery manifest records final integrated source hashes.
No claim that exhaustive inspection proves absence of every possible defect, or that future strategy profitability or benchmark outperformance is established.
